Cats by Post
The refinementsFree fontsWhere things live
Earlier directions

Still room.
For everything.

The close camera stays. Pause gets a permanent home. The tray changes with the job, so a late shift has everything it needs without becoming a wall of controls.

The four directions, refined against busier play, multiple hatches and the rest of the game. Every font shown here is free and open source.

Try the refinements

The previous eleven embedded fonts were already free. This edition makes that explicit and adds Texturina, Balthazar and Quando. The commercial suggestions have been left in the earlier sketchbook.

Ginger & blue Ⅱ Pause
Next
Plain ×1
Send the post
Leave room
for the room.

The camera is yours.

Zoom and pan the world. The controls stay put, at a readable size. A single action brings the whole room back.

The HUD travels light.

Arrivals, pieces, Send. Everything else appears when it earns its space. Fold the tray to open up the view.

Give it a voice.

Lettering with warmth, ink and a little oddness. More of a game’s title and a postmistress’s tools.

The same four directions.
A fuller little job.

Pause and the mode’s status stay in the same place. Arrivals unfold when needed. Each direction carries the same complete control system and its own free type pairing.

Give the desk a busier day.

Independent interface prototype using still game artwork and sample progress. The demonstration clock can pause and resume. The game’s simulation, saved data and controls are unchanged; story pause is a proposed addition.

A free font can
have a proper voice.

Fourteen real, embedded families. All are free and open source under the SIL Open Font License, including use in commercial games under its terms. The three new finds lead this list; the original candidates follow.

The little words matter, too.

All fourteen embedded families use the SIL Open Font License. The specimens here contain a reduced Latin character set for a compact, offline sketchbook. Full font licences and copyright notices are included below. No font fees or subscriptions are needed for these candidates. Copyright notices and licences stay with the font files. Read the OFL.

A place for every
part of the post.

The control map keeps the whole game in view. Some things stay visible, some earn a temporary surface, and the quieter tools live behind Pause. The room remains the main event.

MomentAlways closeWhen neededPut by
Story planningPause, delivery title, home count, next arrivals, available stock, Send.Full hatch queues, Clear, Hint, camera pocket.Delivery book, chapter story, rules, restart and comfort.
Cats travellingPause stays visible. Send becomes Stop. Arrivals advance.Expand a queue. Refit or pan the room.Piece editing and hints wait until the attempt stops.
A wrong route / timeoutThe room stays visible with a specific status and Try again.Explain the puzzled cat or unfinished journey; allow route edits and Clear.No success stamps. Keep the attempted route for another arrangement.
PausedResume, the frozen counts and the current arrangement.Study the board without resuming. Night Shift can still be edited.Restart, postcards, guide, comfort; shift identity and ending.
Three hatchesNumbered next-cat previews in the compact strip.One ticket with named, numbered rows and full release order.Mechanism explanations in the guide, rather than extra stock buttons.
Daily PostDated identity, the same puzzle tray, Pause and one hint.Saved attempts and streak on its envelope; Share after solving.Practice when today’s puzzle is finished or unavailable.
PracticeThe puzzle and its weekday difficulty.Another puzzle, difficulty choice, saved seeds, optional learned pieces.Optional future points, tunnels and big cats appear after their rooms exist.
Night Shift setupPause, round, cats home, three strikes, stock, ordered arrivals, Go and speed.Numbered hatch markers, full release ticket and Clear.Weekly/random selection, seed, restart and ending.
Night Shift runningPause, round progress, home count, strikes and persistent ×1/×2.Live turntable editing and arrivals. Pausing freezes all shift time.No story Hint or Send action. A paused setup explicitly waits for Go.
Tea breakThree eligible cards. The room waits.Extra turntables, coat pieces, More floor, Slow day, Wake-up call or Walkies.Choose before editing. Next round stays paused until Go.
WalkiesA clear two-step instruction and the selected dog.Tap the dog, then a fair empty destination.Stock editing resumes after the move. Go remains disabled until then.
ResultsDelivered, Tidy and First post for puzzles; a shift summary for Night Shift.Next, Share, retry, another Practice puzzle or Finish chapter.Chapter finale/satchel exit, best results and saved collection progress.
PostcardsPlace identity and next chapter.Two office chapters, two depot chapters, stamps, story and rules-driven demo.Future rooms: train, city hall, parcel room and Christmas. Six places / eight chapters.
Cat albumEight coat stamps, earned and locked.Starting four; smoke at 50, calico 100, tortoiseshell 250, Siamese 500.Collection is earned through completed shifts and appears on Box Room stacks.
WorkshopSeparate editor tools, structured queues, Check and Try.Import/export, full mechanism palette and a clear Back to Workshop in trial play.No editor controls or debug panels in the normal player HUD.

Future mechanisms get room on the board and in the guide. Railway points and tunnels are fixed mechanisms; they do not become extra tray stock. Big cats are marked in arrivals. This keeps the next chapters from gradually turning the HUD into a catalogue.

A consistent pause.

Same corner, same minimum touch target, independent of the folded tray. Escape opens Pause; a paused shift can be studied and edited without time advancing.

Space for the board.

Fit and camera controls live in a small pocket. In a real integration, board fitting must account for the visible tray, all destinations and the current room growth.

A free, coherent voice.

I would refine Grenze + Signika first, keep Della Respira + Ysabeau as the quieter pairing, and test Balthazar as a new title candidate. All are free / OFL.

The room still leads.

The refinements add control coverage without asking the camera to retreat. A busy shift should feel like a busier postal job, with the same few reliable objects to hand.

Pause, arrivals and the current primary action are the anchors. Everything else can unfold from them.

A proper place
for the late post.

Balthazar is a free
little discovery.

The earlier visuals remain in the second sketchbook. These refinements are still independent of the game.

Cats by Post · Third interface sketchbook · November 202614 free fonts. No game integration. No eyebrow headers.
